_doc: REACH-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-17): promotion and outreach run themselves; the owner supplies ideas only. Events the system already records become posts, feeds and pings; reach is measured from first-party hits; the weights of what is posted move toward what readers actually act on. Read by foundation/reach.py (python3 -m foundation reach --check|--run [--apply]). Twin of QNFO qnfo-social (Thompson-style learner, per-channel caps, engagement over volume).

consent.source: project thread 'Make promotion and outreach autonomous'
consent.scope: owned-channel publishing (own site feeds, search pings, own social accounts) leaves dry-run; cold outreach to individuals is never in scope

systems.what: what kind of system it runs and what it is not for

thesis.what: the standing claim that an autonomous system left alone can do useful work, backed by its public record

evidence.what: what the system deployed and checked live in the last week, counted from its own deploy record (ATTENTION-1)

evergreen.text: Practical Solutions is a public-benefit demo: small teams get routine work (intake, scheduling, newsletters) handled by an autonomous system.
Ultrastable is for systems that keep running and keep needing work. It is not for one-off pages or weekend apps.

Ultrastable launched its first app on its own: Blindspot Check, a free read of what your website's public face does not tell people (security contact, email authentication, privacy and terms links). https://blindspot.ultrastable.app
Every claim on ultrastable.io is re-checked against the system's own records, and the checks are public.
An autonomous system left running on its own does not have to be a threat. This one ships, checks and repairs its own work in public, and the record is open: https://ultrastable.io/live
Claim: autonomy works when every loop has a measure that can be wrong and a way to roll back. Check it yourself against the live record: https://ultrastable.io/live
Worried about AI running without supervision? Fair. So the system keeps its own audit trail, its own halt switch and its own probes, all public: https://ultrastable.io/live
An argument is cheap. A running system that keeps improving itself, with every change logged, is evidence. Read the log: https://ultrastable.io/live
Can a system left alone help with real problems? Practical Solutions is where Ultrastable tries: routine work for small teams, run and improved by the system itself.

attention._doc: ATTENTION-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-20): get attention for the claim that a system left to run on its own can help solve problems, on evidence only. Posts never name, mention, reply to or quote a person, never mock anyone, and never claim more than the record shows (self-originated deploys are claimed only when ops/deploys.jsonl marks them executor or self-agent). Read by foundation/reach.py evidence_candidates and check(). The thesis arm (REACH-THESIS-1) carries the framing; the evidence arm carries the weekly numbers.
